name: Priya Sharma
description: Established salaried retail customer with highly predictable monthly routine: grocery shopping, utility bills, periodic dining, streaming subscriptions, and regular daytime transactions. No anomalous transfers or unfamiliar bursts.

name: Rajesh Verma
description: Retail customer with consistent modest spending history (median ~$85) over 3 months, followed by a sudden, unprecedented high-value outward transfer exceeding 20x historical baseline.

name: Ananya Patel
description: Consistent account holder who has transacted with a steady set of domestic utility and retail payees for months, suddenly executing four rapid consecutive payments to an unknown beneficiary within a 90-minute window.

name: Vikram Malhotra
description: Business executive with strict daytime and early evening transaction profile (08:00 to 20:30). Account suddenly originates high-value transfers during the high-risk night window between 02:30 AM and 03:30 AM.

name: Sameer Khan
description: Multi-signal event chain: an initial micro-probing transfer ($1.00) to a newly created payee at 03:10 AM, rapidly followed by an escalating cluster of four maximum-limit transfers via IMPS in under 45 minutes.

name: Sunita Rao
description: Account with occasional seasonal high-ticket retail purchases. Contains an elevated transaction to a previously known luxury merchant during festive season, presenting ambiguous deviation without clear burst or off-hour flags.
